text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to two months of dedicated effort, 
while not a complete cure, Vivlos 
recovered enough to run in races without 
issue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos reveals that the Triple Tiara has 
become her true dream as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the fans and Trainer who support her— 
Vivlos psyched herself up for the first 
leg of the Triple Tiara: the Oka Sho.
